correctness.rationale: Exact inclusion-exclusion over points falling in the central disk gives (1−t)^4 Q(t)=Q0−4tQ1(t)+6t²Q2(t)+O(t³). The fixed-location triangle containment law yields F(u)=1/4−6u²/π²+o(u²), and the independent expected triangle area M(u)=4/(9π)+2u²/(3π)+o(u²); hence Q1(t)=3/4−4/(3π²)+2t/π²+o(t). Two collapsing points yield a uniform relative direction, so their convexity probability tends to 1−α/π and averages to 1/2. Expansion yields coefficient 1−95/(6π²)≈−0.604252074337. Uniform local Taylor remainder and dominated convergence justify interchange; affine invariance handles homothetic ellipses. Finite simulations alone could not establish this limit.
